_comment: Frozen retrieval baselines. A drop of more than `tolerance` below `value`
fails CI. Update deliberately, in the same PR that causes the change, with
the paired-bootstrap delta in the commit message — never to make a red
Measured on the 42-paper frozen corpus with 472 ICT queries, hash
embeddings, retrieval scoped to one paper (matching production).
tolerance is 0.005, not the CI half-width (~0.028). The point estimate is
fully deterministic — same corpus, same queries, no sampling in retrieval —
so run-to-run variance is zero and the gate only needs to absorb rounding.
A tolerance set to the CI width would let a real regression through:
disabling IDF in BM25 costs 0.013, which a 0.02 tolerance does not catch.
